description: 14-byte prefix: a longer name that starts with _Static_assert is a keyword
13-byte keyword plus a letter is not
escaped newline does not continue a string literal
escaped newline does not continue a // comment
backslash-newline does continue a preprocessor line
number runs swallow identifier characters, but stop at a sign
non-ASCII byte is punctuation, and splits an identifier
function = word then blanks then ( ; a newline stops the lookahead
keyword before ( is a keyword, not a function
words are cut at 14 bytes: 15-letter identifier is plain identifier
keyword inside a comment or string stays comment/string
lone slash and star are punctuation
